data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'vonos', meaning 'victory, conqueror'. This name is given to a girl symbolizing the triumph of the spirit over challenges. The name Vonni carries the meaning “Winner, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Vonni usually hope their child will grow to embody winner, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
